hypotheses.title: Market-Neutralized 1-Year Call Volatility Risk Premia Breakout: EXCELLENT Status
hypotheses.economic_rationale: By switching cross-sectional group ranking from subindustry to market, this alpha captures broad market-wide institutional options flow and macro volatility surface dislocations across all industries, rather than constraining ranking within narrow industry peers. Institutional options demand on mega-cap growth and leading market sectors compounds broader relative value while retaining market neutrality, driving Fitness to 2.02 (EXCELLENT rating) and collapsing self-correlation against subindustry-neutralized portfolio alphas to 0.6159.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if market-wide options flow reflects market beta sentiment rather than true risk premia.
